No duplicates found in `cli/cli` for this specific issue. I've verified the root cause directly in source: at commit `cba9646b8c254a5711ef9e19e1dfc1455e88feaa`, [`Extension.UpdateAvailable`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/cba9646b8c254a5711ef9e19e1dfc1455e88feaa/pkg/cmd/extension/extension.go#L214-L221) simply checks `CurrentVersion() != LatestVersion()` with no semantic version precedence, so any differing tag (including an older stable release vs. a newer prerelease) is reported as an available update. This confirms the reported behavior is a real bug rather than user error, since it affects both the manual `gh extension upgrade` path and the automatic update notifier. I'm suggesting `bug`, `priority-3` (edge case limited to pinned prerelease installs, with a workaround of not blindly running `--force`), and `gh-extension` as labels for maintainer review.
